outcome: Length of stay of neonates in the intensive care unit
cohort: 204 women who experienced PPROM between 24 and 34 weeks of gestation at a single tertiary center between 2009 and 2013.
finding: While a latency period >72 hours after PPROM was associated with a higher risk of chorioamnionitis and placental abruption, it did not significantly affect adverse neonatal outcomes and was associated with a decreased length of stay in the NICU.
